message.jaymoskingdoms.war.declared: %s has declared war on %s! The armies muster: the war begins in %s minutes.

message.jaymoskingdoms.war.not_realm: Only kingdoms and fiefdoms go to war.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.already: There is already a war with %s.

message.jaymoskingdoms.war.which: Your realm is in more than one war: name the enemy.

message.jaymoskingdoms.war.ended_op: The war between %s and %s has been called off.

message.jaymoskingdoms.war.spoils_home: The spoils are home in %s: %s silver to its treasury, %s to you.

message.jaymoskingdoms.war.peace.npc_acc: The ruler of %s accepts the offer of peace.
